manifest_gt_provenance: dataset auxiliary annotations (pseudo-GT, not human annotation). seg05/GT-A: info.json text_boxes where model=='text_seg' and score>=0.5. union/GT-B: merged text_seg(>=0.3) + text_ctd + uncleaned_boxes, greedy union merge at IoU>=0.5. union manifests also carry supplementary_boxes = auxiliary text evidence outside GT for FP attribution.

thresholds.comment: M2-DOCTR-QUAL-PREFLIGHT default quality thresholds (user-directed 2026-09-29). Matching is one-to-one greedy by descending confidence; a detection matches a GT box when IoU >= iou_match_threshold.
thresholds.severe_page_miss_definition: a region with >= severe_page_miss_min_gt GT boxes and zero matched detections; rate is over regions that contain at least one GT box

fp_attribution_raw.note: FPs scored against manifest supplementary_boxes (auxiliary text evidence outside the GT subset); overlap>=0.3 counts as GT-coverage FP, otherwise pure false positive

verdict_vs_default_thresholds.judging_layer: block_coverage (production merged blocks vs block-level GT, coverage = intersection/gt_area >= 0.5); raw_strict kept for granularity diagnosis only, never judged
